budget_consumed_minutes.description: Charged incident minutes inside the rolling 7-day window as of the planning date.

budget_reserve_minutes.description: Reserve floor the policy protects inside the weekly SLO budget.

budget_roll_date.description: First date on which the spendable weekly budget covers the planned downtime (ISO date).

business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

coverage_item_or_resource.description: Immutable item or resource whose requirement and eligible coverage were reconciled.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

earliest_qualified_base_window.description: First eligible LANE-WEB session on or after standard package readiness (ISO date).

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

expedite_completion_days_saved.description: Days the early-access package saves after the budget roll and the freeze are reapplied.

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Sablegate's confirmed standard and early-access migration package dates on SGA-2026-074.

external_recovery_quantity.description: Uncovered BUDGET_MINUTE that the external recovery must cover.

freeze_end_date.description: Last day of the peak-trading freeze (ISO date).

ineligible_coverage_quantity.description: charged incident minutes plus the 5-minute reserve floor

observed_coverage_quantity.description: Gross observed coverage for spendable merchant-portal error-budget minutes in the rolling 7-day window before exclusions.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit shared by the requirement and coverage calculations: BUDGET_MINUTE.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing post_freeze_monday_window, expedite_migration_package, freeze_exception_saturday.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

required_quantity.description: planned downtime minutes the SGA-2026-074 migration needs at the current 6-minute restart metering (2 edge restarts + 4 minutes validation)

restart_minutes.description: Restart-to-healthy minutes from the current final RESTART-MIN metering, not the stale one.

restarts_required.description: Edge restarts the migration package requires.

selected_lane_window.description: Lane and session used by the selected option, as LANE/YYYY-MM-DD/SESSION.

shortage_quantity.description: Uncovered BUDGET_MINUTE after netting eligible coverage from the requirement.

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Sablegate's confirmed standard and early-access migration package dates on SGA-2026-074.

usable_coverage_quantity.description: Net eligible coverage after removing charged incident minutes plus the 5-minute reserve floor.

validation_minutes.description: Post-change validation minutes from the service runbook.

decision_model.binding_constraint: the weekly error-budget policy and the peak-trading freeze on the web lane; charged incident minutes plus the 5-minute reserve floor = 42 BUDGET_MINUTE; uncovered scope = 8 BUDGET_MINUTE

calculations.description: Preserved 2026-04-22 as the documented control date for the merchant portal TLS profile migration; did not infer urgency from a title or a request tone.
Derived 16 BUDGET_MINUTE for planned downtime minutes the SGA-2026-074 migration needs at the current 6-minute restart metering (2 edge restarts + 4 minutes validation) at revision v1.
Read 50 BUDGET_MINUTE of gross observed spendable merchant-portal error-budget minutes in the rolling 7-day window.
Excluded 42 BUDGET_MINUTE for charged incident minutes plus the 5-minute reserve floor.
Calculated 50 observed − 42 ineligible = 8 usable BUDGET_MINUTE.
Calculated 16 required − 8 usable = 8 BUDGET_MINUTE uncovered.
Kept every planning quantity in BUDGET_MINUTE.
Calculated post_freeze_monday_window outcome as 2026-04-20 under free LANE-WEB sessions outside the peak-trading freeze.
Calculated expedite_migration_package outcome as 2026-04-20 using Sablegate's confirmed standard and early-access migration package dates on SGA-2026-074.
Calculated freeze_exception_saturday outcome as 2026-04-18 and kept its separate-approval condition.
Read 2026-04-20 as the independently confirmed standard readiness date for Sablegate's confirmed standard and early-access migration package dates on SGA-2026-074.
Read 2026-04-15 as the independently confirmed expedited readiness date for Sablegate's confirmed standard and early-access migration package dates on SGA-2026-074.
Bound external recovery to the 8 BUDGET_MINUTE uncovered requirement rather than ordering the full header quantity.
Read 2 edge restarts from SGA-2026-074 (profile load, then session-cache flush).
Used the 2026-04-08 RESTART-MIN metering of 6 minutes, not the 3-minute January metering or the vendor's 6-minute total estimate.
Added the runbook's 4 validation minutes: 2 x 6 + 4 = 16 minutes of planned downtime.
Summed the charged incidents in the (2026-04-07, 2026-04-14] weekly window: INC-70868 (28) + INC-70875 (9) = 37; excluded INC-70801 (outside the window) and INC-70871 (reclassified).
Applied the 5-minute reserve floor: 50 - 37 - 5 = 8 spendable minutes, 8 short of the 16 required.
Derived 2026-04-16 as the first day INC-70868 leaves the 7-day window (50 - 9 - 5 = 36 spendable).
Read the peak-trading freeze (2026-04-16 to 2026-04-19, every lane) from the freeze register.
Identified Monday 2026-04-20 NIGHT as the first free LANE-WEB session on or after the 2026-04-20 standard readiness.
Bound the new change to LANE-WEB/2026-04-20/NIGHT, the first session that is free, budget-eligible, and covered by a certified secondary.
Compared the 2026-04-15 early-access readiness with the budget roll and the freeze: the first eligible session is still 2026-04-20, so the USD 250 package saves 0 days.
Applied USD 0 as the documented incremental cost for post_freeze_monday_window; did not invent a premium where spend is not a decision driver.
Recognized that freeze_exception_saturday remains outside current authority and requires an additional approval.

Compared the timing, cost, control status, and consequence of post_freeze_monday_window, expedite_migration_package, freeze_exception_saturday; selected post_freeze_monday_window because it alone gives the best currently authorized result under the weekly error-budget policy and the peak-trading freeze on the web lane.
Calculated 2026-04-20 as the supported outcome date for post_freeze_monday_window.
Compared 2026-04-20 with the independent control date 2026-04-22 and calculated a signed variance of -2 day(s).
Reported ON_TIME; did not relabel a controlled but late result as on time.

facts.rubric: Used the independently confirmed 2026-04-15 early-access readiness input for expedite_migration_package, then separately derived its 2026-04-20 operating outcome under the weekly error-budget policy and the peak-trading freeze on the web lane instead of treating a vendor date as authorization or a completion date.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-SO-0107 only to post_freeze_monday_window and SLO-MRP-AVAIL; kept freeze_exception_saturday outside current authority.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected post_freeze_monday_window: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies the weekly error-budget policy and the peak-trading freeze on the web lane.
facts.statement: the portal must be migrated before the legacy profile is disabled on 2026-04-22; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside the weekly error-budget policy and the peak-trading freeze on the web lane.

options.consequence: post-freeze Monday window raises a standard change on the standard package (eligible 2026-04-20) into LANE-WEB's 2026-04-20 NIGHT session, the first session after the peak-trading freeze with the weekly budget rolled, two days before the legacy profile is disabled, at no incremental cost.

options.consequence: expedite migration package would have the package eligible on 2026-04-15 for USD 250, but only 8 budget minutes are spendable until 2026-04-16 and the peak-trading freeze protects every lane through 2026-04-19, so the first eligible session is still 2026-04-20 and it saves 0 days.

options.label: freeze_exception_saturday: outcome 2026-04-18, incremental cost USD 250, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED
